stem:
Meera watches different objects in motion around her home and school. She wants to identify which one shows oscillatory motion — motion that moves to and fro about a fixed position.
Which of the following is an example of oscillatory motion?

options.text: The minute hand of the wall clock moving around the dial
The swing in the park moving back and forth after Rohan pushes it
A ball rolling in a straight line across the classroom floor
A bus travelling from Chennai to Madurai along a highway

teacher.key_rationale: Oscillatory motion is to-and-fro motion about a fixed position. Only the swing moves back and forth about its mean (hanging) position. The clock hand is circular/rotational motion, the ball is straight-line (rectilinear) motion, and the bus is non-repeating rectilinear motion. Key: B.
